title: Modeling Tabular Data using CTGAN and TabDDPM
summary: A CS787 course project that forks the CTGAN library in-tree and adds architectural novelties (transformer generator, adaptive Gumbel-softmax temperature, pluggable normalization) alongside a new TabDDPM diffusion synthesizer, evaluated in an analysis notebook. The repository vendors and modifies CTGAN's source code (ctgan/synthesizers/ctgan.py, ctgan/synthesizers/tvae.py) and optionally uses SDMetrics' QualityReport for evaluation.
